SELECT
FROM cms_post p
p.status = #{status}
AND
( p.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR p.slug ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.summary, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.content, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.author, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') )
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

p.status = #{status}
